description: Fork of exp567 (E=96, 1.4768 @ 103M). SINGLE change: replace all TinyMultiHeadLut with standard MultiHeadLut(smooth_mode=True, n_alternatives=3). Reference: exp386 showed MHLut(smooth, n_alt=3) beat TinyMHLut soft baseline by ~5 millibits at 3x inference cost. Tests whether the architectural backbone we ended up with (exp567's E=96 setup) benefits from the older 'smooth + 3 alternatives' LUT path. Same NAP/tph/n_outputs across all 4 LUT modules. Compute cost: ~3x wall-clock per step (n_alt=3 = 3x table lookups; smooth mode requires the rational softmax over rows). Running in parallel with exp609 (vanilla bs=96 8K baseline).
